HOW I WORK

Research → measure → acquire → convert → retain → scale.

01 · BUSINESS / MARKET

Market, competitor, audience, customer problem, intent, offer and positioning.

02 · MEASUREMENT

GA4, GTM, pixels/CAPI, conversion definitions, UTMs, Merchant Center and reporting.

03 · DISCOVERY

Paid + organic: Meta, Google, SEO, AEO/GEO/SXO, social and marketplace discovery.

04 · WEBSITE / FUNNEL

Landing pages, product pages, message match, trust, offer, UX and conversion paths.

05 · RETARGET / CRM

Intent-based audiences, WhatsApp, email, abandoned-cart, replenishment, cross-sell and win-back.

06 · ANALYTICS

Diagnose the bottleneck, test the hypothesis, learn, optimise the unit economics and scale.

“If I can’t measure it, I don’t scale it.”
Working principle reflected across the portfolio: measurement first, then scale.
